        elif final_y < final_o:
            return -10000
        return 0
    
    def alphabeta(y, o, depth, alpha, beta, maximizing):
        if is_terminal(y, o):
            return terminal_value(y, o)
        if depth == 0:
            return evaluate(y, o)
        
        if maximizing:
            value = -float('inf')
            moves = [i for i in range(6) if y[i] > 0]
            # Sort: extra moves first
            moves.sort(key=lambda m: 0 if y[m] == 6 - m else 1)
            for m in moves:
                ny, no, extra = apply_move(y, o, m)
                if extra:
                    v = alphabeta(ny, no, depth - 1, alpha, beta, True)
                else:
                    v = alphabeta(ny, no, depth - 1, alpha, beta, False)
                value = max(value, v)
                alpha = max(alpha, value)
                if alpha >= beta:

            return value
        else:
            value = float('inf')
            moves = [i for i in range(6) if o[i] > 0]
            moves.sort(key=lambda m: 0 if o[m] == 6 - m else 1)
            for m in moves:
                no, ny, extra = apply_move(o, y, m)  # Note swap
                if extra:
                    v = alphabeta(ny, no, depth - 1, alpha, beta, False)
                else:
                    v = alphabeta(ny, no, depth - 1, alpha, beta, True)
                value = min(value, v)
                beta = min(beta, value)
                if alpha >= beta:
                    break
            return value
    
    # Get legal moves
    legal = [i for i in range(6) if you_t[i] > 0]
    if not legal:

    # Iterative deepening or fixed depth

        if score > best_score:

            best_move = m
        alpha = max(alpha, score)
